name: Tiamat
oracle_text:
Flying
When Tiamat enters, if you cast it, search your library for up to five Dragon cards not named Tiamat that each have different names, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
blocked_sentences: When Tiamat enters, if you cast it, search your library for up to five Dragon cards not named Tiamat that each have different names, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.

needs.what: a cross-pick distinctness constraint on a multi-card search -- the search_library/search_zones twin of the existing `share_subtype`, e.g. `distinct_names: true`, meaning each card chosen must have a different name from every card already chosen this search. It is a small addition in the same place `share_subtype` lives: `_search` in src/automtg/engine/effects/ops_cards.py already branches to `_search_sharing` when `share_subtype` and take > 1, and this wants the mirror-image staged prompt -- offer the whole pool, then after each pick narrow the remaining pool by excluding cards whose name matches any pick so far, repeating up to `count`. This unblocks Tiamat and every 'search for up to N cards that each have different names' card (the Dragon/Sliver/'Primevals' family).
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `share_subtype` is the only between-the-picks constraint the search ops have, and it is the opposite relation (cards that MATCH each other, on subtype, not cards that DIFFER, on name) -- its `_search_sharing` helper hardcodes a subtype intersection against the first pick's `chars().subtypes` and offers no name reading at all. No selector clause can stand in: `_matches_in_zone` evaluates every clause against one candidate in isolation, which is exactly what the `_search_sharing` docstring says ('A constraint between the picks, which no selector can state'). `shares_a_name_with` is the nearest name clause and it compares against an object already in `ctx.bindings`, and nothing binds a card the same search is still choosing. Running five one-card `search_library` ops in sequence is a different card: five separate 'up to one' counts, five shuffles, and still no way to exclude the earlier picks' names.

needs.what: a name-negation selector clause -- the `not_colors`/`not_types`/`not_subtypes` twin for names, e.g. `not_name: "Tiamat"` (or a list, `not_names`), matched against `card.name` the way the existing literal `name` clause is. One line in `_matches_in_zone` in src/automtg/engine/effects/selectors.py beside the `name` clause at line 777, plus the key in the selector key set. It unblocks every 'not named <this card>' line -- the legend-rule tutors, Relentless Rats' inverse, and Tiamat's 'Dragon cards not named Tiamat'.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `name` is a positive exact match only (`if (want := selector.get("name")) and card.name != want: return False`) and there is no generic `not` wrapper around a selector -- the negations that exist are the fixed set `not_colors`, `not_keywords`, `not_types`, `not_subtypes`, `not_supertypes`, none of which reads a name. `exclude_self` is not it either: it excludes THIS object, and the card being excluded here is a different copy of Tiamat sitting in the library, which `exclude_self` never sees. `shares_a_name_with` is positive and needs a bound object. Leaving the clause off would let the search fetch a second Tiamat, which is a real difference in a deck that runs more than one, so it is not a safe approximation.

notes: Everything else on the card is expressible and was checked: `flying` is in keywords; the trigger is `self_enters` with the intervening 'if you cast it' as `condition: {"was_cast": true}`; 'up to five' is native to `_search` (it asks with min 0); `reveal: true`, `destination: "hand"` and the trailing shuffle are all `search_library` options. Only the two name constraints block it, and they are independent -- closing just one still leaves the sentence unsayable. Deliberately not written as a partial answer: a search restricted only to `subtypes: ["Dragon"]` would fetch five copies of the same Dragon and a second Tiamat, and dropping the trigger to implement Flying alone would leave the printed line unclaimed and fail the residual gate.
